Route104_Text_ThrowBallAtWeakenedPokemon:
A weakened wild POKéMON is easier to catch. Sleep or paralysis can help, too.

Take care with poison and burns. You don't want it to faint before your POKé BALL reaches it!
Route104_Text_ImNotATrainer:
Oh, no, I'm not a TRAINER. I'm just out for a walk.

Some TRAINERS will challenge you as soon as they see you. Others would rather stop and chat!
Route104_Text_MayHaventRaisedPokemon:
MAY: Okay! We can battle when you're ready.

I've got plenty of POKéDEX notes to sort out in the meantime.
Route104_Text_MayPostBattle:
MAY: We've both come a long way since ROUTE 103!

Are you sailing with MR. BRINEY? Say hello to PEEKO for me. I hope the sea stays calm for you!
Route104_Text_BrendanNoConfidence: BRENDAN: Got somewhere to be? All right. Come find me when you want a battle!
Route104_Text_BrendanIntro: BRENDAN: Ready, {PLAYER}? I've been looking forward to our next battle!
Route104_Text_BrendanPostBattle:
BRENDAN: You've been busy since ROUTE 103. I'll have to keep up!

You're going out to sea with MR. BRINEY, right? Bring back a good story. I'll have one for you, too.
Route111_Text_TrainerTipsSpAtkSpDef:
TRAINER TIPS

SP. ATK means SPECIAL ATTACK. It determines the power of special moves.

SP. DEF means SPECIAL DEFENSE. It helps a POKéMON withstand them.
Route111_Text_DynamoGuardTrigger:
Hey! Not past the rope. Storm damage has made the northern trail unsafe.

You'll need WATTSON's DYNAMO BADGE before I can let you through.
Route117_Text_ArentTheseFlowersPretty:
Aren't these flowers pretty? I love watching the POKéMON wander through them.

Lately, an odd one with a metal mask has been hiding in the grass. DEVON calls it TYPE: NULL.

With the KNUCKLE BADGE, you can search for it here. It's very rare, but SWEET SCENT helps draw it out.
Route117_Text_DayCarePokemonHadNewMove:
I left two compatible POKéMON at the DAY CARE, and they produced an EGG!

I wonder what the little one will be like. Waiting to meet it is the hardest part!
Route118_Text_MagikarpGuyChallenge:
People see my MAGIKARP and smile. I don't mind. I smiled when I caught it!

Care to battle my fishing team?
Route118_Text_MagikarpGuyDefeat: Well caught! That was a good battle.
Route118_Text_MagikarpGuyAfter:
Every partner has a story. Mine usually starts with a fishing rod and a very long wait.

Even that little MAGIKARP made me work for it!
Route121_Text_AheadLoomsMtPyre:
Ahead looms MT. PYRE…

It is a natural monument to the spirits of departed POKéMON…
Route123_Text_YouLikeGrassMonsTooHaveThi:
Oh? You like GRASS-type POKéMON, too!

Here, take this SWEET APPLE from the orchard. Use it on APPLIN to evolve it into APPLETUN.
Route123_Text_RouteSignMtPyre:
{UP_ARROW} MT. PYRE

Travelers report TAPU BULU in the grass on ROUTE 123. Search with the FEATHER BADGE.

It is a rare wild discovery. SWEET SCENT may help you find it.
VerdanturfTown_House_Text_DefeatEliteFou:
The ELITE FOUR face challengers one after another, with the CHAMPION waiting beyond them.

Imagine standing at that first door! I'd need a moment to catch my breath.
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Furfro: A fine FURFROU deserves a fine trim! Would yours like a new cut?
All done! {STR_VAR_1} has a lovely new look.
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Nothin:
You've earned every scarf I have!

Do keep visiting with your POKéMON. Seeing them flourish is a joy!
MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ExplainRockSmas:
That HM registers ROCK SMASH for your team!

With the DYNAMO BADGE and a compatible partner, you can smash cracked rocks in your path.

No need to use a battle move slot. Smash rocks aside, I say! Woohoo!
LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_Girls:
I love watching young TRAINERS discover what their POKéMON can do.

A pair of TWINS surprised me with their teamwork. They'd practiced together for ages!

Whoop! That's the joy of battling!
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WantCuteMo:
Ohh, seeing all these cute POKéMON makes me want to meet one of my own!

I'm going to go look for a partner!
LilycoveCity_House2_Text_NotAwakeYetHave:
Huh? What? Oh, a visitor…

I was admiring this MOON STONE and drifted off. You can have it… Yawn…
LilycoveCity_House2_Text_SleepIsEssentia:
Yawn… A MOON STONE can help certain POKéMON evolve…

Me? A little more sleep will do nicely…
AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattIntro:
MATT: You made it through the whole hideout? Ha! You've got guts.

ARCHIE's nearly ready to sail. I just need to keep you busy a little longer!
AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattDefeat: Ha… You don't give up, do you?
AquaHideout_B2F_Text_OurBossGotThroughHi: MATT: You beat me, but you're too late! ARCHIE's ready to dive!
AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattPostBattle:
MATT: ARCHIE's headed for a cavern beneath ROUTE 128.

Go on, chase him! You'll need DIVE to follow a submarine down there.

You'll need MOSSDEEP's BADGE and DIVE. Ask STEVEN for help, if you can find him! ARCHIE will be miles ahead.
AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4Intro:
I've been waiting here so long my feet have gone numb.

At last! An intruder! I knew this post mattered!
AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4Defeat: All that waiting, and I still lost…
AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle:
Even a little delay helps ARCHIE get the submarine ready.

That's what I'm putting in my report, anyway.
AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6Intro:
Warp panels! The pride of our hideout!

I know exactly where you came from. Let's see if you can get past me!
SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyIntro:
SHELLY: You reached the seafloor without a submarine… Impressive.

First the WEATHER INSTITUTE, now here. You really intend to stop ARCHIE.

Then you'll have to get past me again!
SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyDefeat: You've grown stronger since we met…
SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyPostBatt:
SHELLY: We wanted more room for sea POKéMON to live. That's why I joined AQUA.

ARCHIE is beyond this room. I hope he still remembers why we came.
SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Intro:
Our submarine brought us this far. Your POKéMON brought you.

They're tough, I'll give you that. But I'm not letting you through!
SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5PostBatt:
I joined AQUA because I love the sea.

I thought I'd feel at home down here. Now I just want to see the sky again.
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseA:
WALLY: {PLAYER}! I was hoping I'd see you!

When we met, I couldn't imagine traveling this far from home. Now look at us!

My uncle still worries, so I call whenever I reach a new town.

This time, I want to tell him I won. Here I come!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyEntranceDefeat: We gave it everything we had…
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostEntranceBat:
WALLY: I wanted to win so badly…

But I'm glad you were here to see how far we've come. I'll keep going, {PLAYER}. You can count on that!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyIntro:
WALLY: {PLAYER}! Welcome back!

We've been training since our last battle. I wanted you to see us!

All right… Here we come!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostBattle:
WALLY: I used to be afraid to lose. Now every battle makes me want to try again.

Someday, I'll meet you at the LEAGUE. Until then, let's keep helping each other grow!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarPostBattle:
You've made it this far. Keep going and become the CHAMPION!

They say VICTINI appears on this floor to TRAINERS with all eight BADGES. A rare bit of luck on a hard road!

Try SWEET SCENT if you're looking for it.
MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro:
This corner is my post. Nobody gets past it while I'm on duty!

MAXIE is counting on us. I won't let him down!
MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat: I couldn't hold my own post…
MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle:
I thought standing guard would be the easy job.

The digging crew warned me. I should have listened.
MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2Intro:
Our leader told us to dig into MT. CHIMNEY, so we dug and dug.

What we found could give HOENN more land than we ever dreamed of!

And you're not getting near it!
MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat: All that digging wore me out…
MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle:
MAXIE is in the deepest chamber. He says the BLUE ORB will awaken what we found.

I hope he knows what he's doing.
MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6Intro:
I used to hate this heat. My POKéMON seem perfectly comfortable!

Maybe they're trying to tell me to stop complaining. Come on, then!
MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6Defeat: Now I really need some fresh air…
MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6PostBattle:
They love it here. I suppose I can put up with a little sweat.

A lot of sweat, actually.
MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8Intro:
Wait. One of ours lost a MAGMA EMBLEM. Is that how you got in?

Oh, he'll hear about this! But first, I've got to deal with you!
BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_Cir:
The CHAMPIONS CIRCUIT welcomes challengers with the FEATHER BADGE.

Return when you've earned it!
BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_Trai:
I went to a different desk hoping for an easier challenge.

They all enter the same CIRCUIT! Now the receptionist recognizes me…
BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_IsYourNa: Have you set a Circuit record you're proud of?
BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WorkHard:
I'm still working on mine, too!

Maybe we can compare our best runs next time.
BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_MyNamesN:
I keep checking my records, but I haven't entered a challenge yet.

Funny how the numbers haven't moved…
BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_EvExplanatio:
For 70 years I have raised POKéMON!

Every partner has the potential to compete. The one you caught today deserves that chance, too.

A CENTER tutor can help you choose its Nature and EVs, or prepare a full battle set.

Then the two of you can get on with the adventure!
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorFre:
Buhahaha! I was the toughest BEAUTY around, and I still know a beautiful move when I see one!

Don't mind her boasting over there. My lessons are free. Let's see your POKéMON!
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorFr:
Ihihihi! I was winning battles while swimming against the current!

She'll tell you she was better. Let her talk! My lessons are free. Let's see your POKéMON!
AlteringCave_1F_Text_Researcher:
This cavern feels like a doorway. The deeper I go, the stranger it becomes.

With the BALANCE BADGE, you may find HOOPA among the wild POKéMON here. It's rare; SWEET SCENT helps.

MEWTWO waits on B1F. It accepts challengers with the MIND BADGE.
AlteringCave_B1F_Text_LeafIntro:
LEAF: I followed reports of strange POKéMON here from KANTO.

There's something powerful in this cavern. Before you go farther, let's see how your team handles mine!
AlteringCave_B1F_Text_LeafAfter:
LEAF: Take this MEWTWONITE X. It can help MEWTWO Mega Evolve.

If you meet it here, I hope the two of you can learn to trust each other.
CaveOfOrigin_DianciesRoom_Text_WallaceIn:
WALLACE: Listen to the water in this chamber. Even a quiet place has its own rhythm.

We've met at the LEAGUE. Here, I'd like to show you another side of my team!
CaveOfOrigin_DianciesRoom_Text_WallaceAf:
WALLACE: What a pleasure to battle you here! The crystals seemed to catch every flash of light.

You needn't win an exhibition to meet DIANCIE or find the DIANCITE here. Take your time exploring!
CaveOfOrigin_DianciesRoom_Text_WallaceOf:
WALLACE: Would you join me for a special exhibition battle here?

I've brought a different team from the one you faced at the LEAGUE.
CaveOfOrigin_DianciesRoom_Text_WallaceNo:
WALLACE: Challenge me at the POKéMON LEAGUE first. Then we can hold a special exhibition here.

You're welcome to explore the chamber in the meantime.
DewfordMeadow_Text_Warden:
A little COSMOG drifted into our meadow. Keep an eye on the grass, even on your first visit!

MELOETTA answers songs. With the KNUCKLE BADGE, bring a partner with SING and we'll perform together.

Once it answers, you can keep looking for it here. We only need to sing together once.

With the HEAT BADGE, you may also spot MUNKIDORI. SWEET SCENT helps draw out these rare visitors.
DewfordMeadow_Text_ManorSign:
DEWFORD MANOR

A sea captain's retreat, later a home for MEGA EVOLUTION research.

Please respect the POKéMON that now shelter inside.
Seaspray_Cave_Text_Explorer:
The shifting tides exposed this cave, but they did not create it.

Explore its deeper chambers. Unusual water POKéMON have made a home beneath the coast.
